title: Optimal Learning in Games with Arbitrary Delays: Best-of-Both-Worlds for Self-Play and Adversarial Opponents
abstract: arXiv:2611.07773v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study learning in zero-sum games with delayed feedback. We introduce Multi-Anchor Optimistic Online Mirror Descent (MAO-OMD), a single algorithm which obtains optimal fast rates in self-play on smooth games, while simultaneously maintaining minimax optimal guarantees against arbitrary opponents. In particular, in smooth zero-sum games with arbitrary and unknown feedback delays, MAO-OMD obtains $O(\sigma_{\max}+1)$ social and individual regrets when used by both players, where $\sigma_{\max}$ denotes the maximum number of outstanding gradients, while also guaranteeing minimax optimal $O(\sqrt{T+d_{\mathrm{tot}}})$ individual regret against arbitrary opponents, where $d_{\mathrm{tot}}$ is the total delay. Moreover, we show that these optimal rates cannot be obtained simultaneously using the standard black-box reduction to the undelayed setting. We also extend our results to multi-player games, and to games with player-dependent delay se

translated_title: 具有任意延迟的博弈中的最优学习：自博弈与对抗对手场景的两全其美
translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有延迟反馈的零和博弈中的学习问题。我们提出了多锚点乐观在线镜像下降算法，这是一种单一算法，能够在光滑博弈的自博弈中获得最优的快速遗憾速率，同时保持对任意对手的极小极大最优保证。特别地，在具有任意且未知反馈延迟的光滑零和博弈中，当双方参与者都使用MAO-OMD时，该算法获得 O(σ_max+1) 的社会遗憾和个体遗憾，其中 σ_max 表示未完成梯度的最大数量；同时对任意对手保证极小极大最优的 O(√(T+d_tot)) 个体遗憾，其中 d_tot 为总延迟。此外，我们证明了通过将问题标准黑盒归约到无延迟设定，无法同时获得这些最优速率。我们还将结果扩展到多人博弈，以及具有参与者相关延迟的博弈。
tldr: 提出单一算法MAO-OMD，在具有任意未知反馈延迟的零和博弈中，同时实现了自博弈时的最优快速遗憾速率 O(σ_max+1) 和对抗任意对手时极小极大最优的 O(√(T+d_tot)) 保证。
en_tdlr: A single algorithm MAO-OMD simultaneously achieves the optimal fast regret rate O(σ_max+1) in self-play and the minimax optimal O(√(T+d_tot)) guarantee against arbitrary opponents in zero-sum games with arbitrary unknown feedback delays.
